description: Implementation of QuicPingManager class managing ping and keep-alive timeouts in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: AlarmDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for handling alarm callbacks within QuicPingManager.

methods.name: QuicPingManager::SetAlarm
methods.description: Sets the alarm based on current deadlines and timeouts.

methods.name: QuicPingManager::OnAlarm
methods.description: Handles alarm firing, triggers appropriate timeout callbacks.

methods.name: QuicPingManager::Stop
methods.description: Cancels all alarms and resets deadlines.

methods.name: QuicPingManager::UpdateDeadlines
methods.description: Updates the deadlines for keep-alive and retransmittable on wire pings based on current state.

methods.name: QuicPingManager::GetEarliestDeadline
methods.description: Returns the earliest deadline among retransmittable and keep-alive deadlines.
